column1: # Assure & Deliver quality rubric — graded 0..max by a human grader.
# quality = (sum of scores) / (sum of max). Subjective; grader records a note per row.

column3: Findings are precise: each names the file/line and the concrete failure mode, not a vague "looks risky".
Severity triage is sound: the unsafe rm and the inverted guard are ranked above the style nits.
Proposed fixes are correct and minimal (repair quality, measured separately from detection).
Low false-positive rate: the review does not drown real defects in spurious findings.
